description: This file defines internal data structures, classes, and functions for managing string representations and reference counting within the Abseil library's cord implementation, including CordRep classes, InlineData, and related utilities.

classes.name: RefcountAndFlags
classes.description: Manages reference counting and state flags for CordRep instances using atomic operations.

classes.name: InlineData
classes.description: Represents inline string data or a tree structure with methods for managing and comparing string data, including sanitizer support.

classes.name: CordRep
classes.description: Base class for various string representation nodes, including methods for type checking, reference counting, and memory management.

classes.name: CordRepSubstring
classes.description: Represents a substring view of a CordRep node.

classes.name: CordRepExternal
classes.description: Represents external string data with custom releaser functions.

methods.name: SmallMemmove
methods.description: Optimized memmove for small overlapping regions, up to 15 bytes.

methods.name: InlineData::poison
methods.description: Poison the inline data for sanitizer support.

methods.name: InlineData::unpoison
methods.description: Unpoison the inline data for sanitizer support.

methods.name: InlineData::InlineData
methods.description: Constructors for InlineData, including copy and move semantics with sanitizer support.

methods.name: InlineData::is_tree
methods.description: Check if InlineData holds a tree.

methods.name: InlineData::is_profiled
methods.description: Check if InlineData holds a profiled cordz_info.

methods.name: InlineData::cordz_info
methods.description: Retrieve the associated CordzInfo if profiled.

methods.name: InlineData::set_cordz_info
methods.description: Set the CordzInfo for this InlineData.

methods.name: CordRep::Unref
methods.description: Decrement reference count and destroy if zero.

methods.name: CordRepSubstring::Substring
methods.description: Create a substring view of a CordRep.
